description: Clone a plugin under a new name in the project, keeping its description. The whole plugin is copied: agents and skills as independent copies, rules, files and the MCP servers with their stored `env`/`headers` values. It counts against the plan limits (plugins, and agents, skills and MCP servers per plugin); a breach creates nothing. `source` is a plugin name, or an id with `byId: true`. The installed plugin is not changed. Without `slug` the server derives one from the new name. A `slug` is refused, writing nothing, with code `plugin_slug_conflict` (409: another plugin of the project has it), `plugin_slug_forbidden` (a reserved slug), `plugin_slug_locked` (the slug of this plugin cannot be changed) or `plugin_slug_invalid` (not a valid slug).

byId.description: The given value is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --by-id <id>).

name.description: The new cloned plugin's name, at most 200 characters.

slug.description: The new cloned plugin's slug (CLI: --slug). Unique in the project; it is the name of the plugin package and the prefix of its commands.

source.description: Name (or, with byId, id) of the plugin to clone.

name: plugins_clone
title: Clone plugin
